methodology.host: official Pi SDK loader, registry, runToolCall and before/after tool hooks; idle session with model stream counter
methodology.governance: Pi local tools and mutation queue; preparatory reads are included in this workflow
methodology.batching: edits are grouped by file in the public edits[] schema; global replace uses a unique full-file oldText/newText
methodology.timed_region: sum of performance.now tool execution durations; file creation, oracle and byte counting are outside
methodology.setup: SDK package/bootstrap timed once; provider session creation includes native capability handshake; one persistent session per lane
methodology.bytes: UTF-8 JSON.stringify public tool arguments and actual result object; SDK control envelope and native IPC have separate boundaries
methodology.p95: nearest rank; three samples give the maximum
methodology.ordering: original provider then native; fixture order; per-fixture warm-up
methodology.scope: local known-input tools and storage bytes; model generation and billing are outside this cohort
